title: French Salade Niçoise
summary: A Provençal salad of tuna, eggs, tomatoes, olives and green beans dressed with sharp Dijon vinaigrette.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Boil eggs 9 minutes and cool; blanch beans 3 minutes and refresh in cold water.

stages.title: Develop the flavour
steps: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice and mustard with salt and pepper until emulsified.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Drain tuna, halve tomatoes and eggs, and arrange lettuce, beans, tuna, olives and eggs on a platter.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Drizzle dressing over just before serving, keeping the ingredients distinct and colourful.

tips: Taste and adjust seasoning at the end; the balance of salt, acidity and texture matters for this dish.
variations: Adjust chilli or fresh herbs to taste without changing the main cooking method.
storage: Refrigerate promptly and eat within 1 day; do not leave at room temperature.

title: Mexican Chilaquiles Verdes
summary: Crisp tortilla triangles softened in tangy green salsa, topped with fried eggs, crema and fresh coriander.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Cut tortillas into triangles and bake at 200°C until crisp; husk and rinse tomatillos.

stages.title: Develop the flavour
steps: Simmer tomatillos, jalapeño, onion and garlic 10 minutes, then blend into a bright green salsa.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Heat salsa in a skillet, add tortilla chips and toss briefly so some edges remain crisp; fry eggs separately.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Top chilaquiles with eggs, sour cream and chopped coriander; serve immediately.

tips: Taste and adjust seasoning at the end; the balance of salt, acidity and texture matters for this dish.
variations: Adjust chilli or fresh herbs to taste without changing the main cooking method.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in a sealed container for up to 2 days; serve chilled or reheat as appropriate.

title: Lebanese Batata Harra
summary: Crisp roasted potatoes tossed with garlic, coriander, chilli and fresh lemon for a lively mezze side.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Heat oven to 220°C and cut potatoes into 2 cm cubes; dry thoroughly.

stages.title: Develop the flavour
steps: Toss potatoes with oil and salt and roast 30–35 minutes, turning once until crisp and golden.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Briefly fry minced garlic and chilli in a little oil, then add chopped coriander off heat.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Toss hot potatoes with fragrant oil and lemon juice and serve while crisp.

tips: Taste and adjust seasoning at the end; the balance of salt, acidity and texture matters for this dish.
variations: Adjust chilli or fresh herbs to taste without changing the main cooking method.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in a sealed container for up to 2 days; serve chilled or reheat as appropriate.

title: Italian Zuppa Toscana
summary: A hearty Tuscan-style soup of sausage, potatoes and kale in a lightly creamy garlic broth.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Slice potatoes thinly, strip kale from stems and remove sausage meat from casings.

stages.title: Develop the flavour
steps: Brown sausage in a large pot until crumbled and golden; soften onion and garlic in the rendered fat.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Add potatoes and stock and simmer 15 minutes until tender; stir in kale and cook 5 minutes more.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Add cream and chilli flakes, warm gently without boiling and season before serving.

tips: Taste and adjust seasoning at the end; the balance of salt, acidity and texture matters for this dish.
variations: Adjust chilli or fresh herbs to taste without changing the main cooking method.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in a sealed container for up to 3 days; reheat until steaming hot.

title: Chinese Egg Drop Soup
summary: Silky ribbons of egg swirl through a light ginger-scented broth with spring onions and white pepper.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Slice ginger and spring onions; beat eggs lightly in a jug with a fork.

stages.title: Develop the flavour
steps: Simmer stock with ginger for 8 minutes, then remove ginger and season with white pepper.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Stir cornflour with water and add to gently simmering broth; pour beaten eggs in a thin stream while stirring slowly in one direction.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Turn off heat, add sesame oil and spring onions and serve immediately.

tips: Taste and adjust seasoning at the end; the balance of salt, acidity and texture matters for this dish.
variations: Adjust chilli or fresh herbs to taste without changing the main cooking method.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in a sealed container for up to 2 days; serve chilled or reheat as appropriate.

title: Moroccan Briouats with Almonds
summary: Crisp triangular pastries filled with fragrant almond paste, cinnamon and orange blossom, dipped in honey.

stages.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps: Heat oven to 190°C; mix almonds, sugar, cinnamon and orange blossom water into a firm paste.

stages.title: Develop the flavour
steps: Cut filo into long strips, brush with butter and place a spoonful of filling at one end.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Fold each strip into a tight triangle, seal edge with butter and bake 15–18 minutes until golden and crisp.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Warm honey gently and dip pastries briefly; drain on a rack before serving.

tips: Taste and adjust seasoning at the end; the balance of salt, acidity and texture matters for this dish.
variations: Adjust chilli or fresh herbs to taste without changing the main cooking method.
storage: Keep covered in the refrigerator for up to 3 days; crisp pastries and fried desserts are best eaten the day they are made.

title: Irish Colcannon
summary: Buttery mashed potatoes folded with tender cabbage and spring onions for a comforting Irish classic.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Peel and quarter potatoes; shred cabbage and slice spring onions.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Boil potatoes in salted water for 18–20 minutes until tender; steam cabbage separately for 5 minutes.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Drain potatoes well and mash with warm milk and butter until fluffy; fold in cabbage and spring onions.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Season generously with pepper and serve with a small well of melted butter.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if appropriate.

title: Japanese Hiyayakko
summary: Chilled silken tofu topped with ginger, spring onions and soy for a clean, refreshing starter.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Chill tofu thoroughly and drain excess liquid without breaking the block.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Grate ginger finely and slice spring onions as thinly as possible.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Cut tofu into four portions with a wet knife and arrange on cold plates.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Top with ginger, onions and sesame; drizzle soy sauce immediately before eating.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if appropriate.

title: Brazilian Pao de Queijo
summary: Chewy, golden cheese rolls made with tapioca starch and Parmesan, crisp outside and stretchy within.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Heat oven to 200°C and grease a mini muffin tin.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Heat milk, oil and salt until just steaming; pour over tapioca starch and stir to hydrate.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Cool briefly, beat in egg and cheese to form a sticky dough; divide between muffin cups.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Bake 18–22 minutes until puffed and golden; serve warm for the best texture.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if appropriate.

title: Italian Pasta e Ceci
summary: Chickpeas and small pasta simmered in a rosemary-scented tomato broth until thick and comforting.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Dice onion and garlic; rinse chickpeas and reserve a handful for garnish.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Soften onion in olive oil 8 minutes; add garlic and rosemary and cook 1 minute.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Add passata, chickpeas and stock; simmer 15 minutes, blend a ladle of chickpeas, then add pasta and cook until tender.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Return blended chickpeas to thicken, season and finish with olive oil.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if appropriate.

title: Mexican Nopales Salad
summary: Tender cactus paddles tossed with tomatoes, onion, coriander and lime for a tangy fresh salad.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Slice nopales into strips and rinse; chop tomatoes and onion finely.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Simmer nopales in salted water 12–15 minutes until tender; drain and rinse to remove excess slime.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Whisk lime juice with olive oil and salt, then toss with cooled nopales and vegetables.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Chill 15 minutes and scatter coriander over before serving.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if appropriate.

title: French Gougeres
summary: Airy choux pastry puffs with nutty Gruyère and a delicate crisp shell.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Heat oven to 200°C and line two trays; grate cheese finely.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Bring water, milk and butter to a boil, add flour at once and stir vigorously until dough pulls from pan.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Cool 5 minutes; beat in eggs one by one, then fold in cheese and pipe small mounds.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Bake 20–25 minutes until deeply golden; avoid opening the oven early or they may collapse.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if appropriate.

title: Korean Hobak Jeon
summary: Tender courgette rounds coated in a light egg batter and pan-fried until delicately golden.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Slice courgettes into 5 mm rounds and sprinkle lightly with salt; pat dry after 10 minutes.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Place flour and beaten eggs in separate shallow dishes.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Dust courgette slices with flour, dip in egg and pan-fry in a lightly oiled skillet 2 minutes each side.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Serve warm with soy sauce and rice vinegar mixed as a dipping sauce.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if appropriate.

title: Vietnamese Che Ba Mau
summary: Colourful layers of sweet beans, pandan jelly and coconut milk served over crushed ice.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Sweeten cooked beans separately with some sugar and cool completely.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Cut pandan jelly into small strips and chill coconut milk.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Layer mung beans, red beans and pandan jelly into tall glasses.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Add crushed ice, pour over coconut milk and serve with a long spoon.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Store covered and chilled for up to 3 days; crisp baked items are best fresh.

title: Italian Sbrisolona
summary: Crumbly almond shortbread from Mantua with a sandy texture and buttery toasted edges.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Heat oven to 170°C and line a 24 cm round tin.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Rub cold butter into flour, polenta, almonds and sugar until coarse crumbs form.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Mix in yolks and zest without kneading smooth; scatter loosely into tin and press only lightly.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Bake 35–40 minutes until golden; cool completely and break into rustic pieces.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Store covered and chilled for up to 3 days; crisp baked items are best fresh.

title: British Bakewell Tart
summary: Buttery pastry layered with raspberry jam and almond frangipane, finished with flaked almonds.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Heat oven to 180°C and line a 23 cm tart tin with pastry; chill 15 minutes.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Blind-bake pastry 15 minutes with weights and 5 minutes without; cream butter and sugar and beat in eggs.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Fold ground almonds into butter mixture; spread jam over pastry base and spoon frangipane on top.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Scatter flaked almonds and bake 30–35 minutes until golden and set; cool before slicing.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Store covered and chilled for up to 3 days; crisp baked items are best fresh.

title: Spanish Crema Catalana
summary: Silky citrus-and-cinnamon custard topped with a brittle layer of caramelised sugar.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Warm milk with cinnamon and citrus peels; steep 10 minutes and strain.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Whisk yolks with 60 g sugar and cornflour until smooth.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Slowly whisk warm milk into yolks, return to pan and stir over low heat until thick; divide among ramekins and chill.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Sprinkle remaining sugar thinly and caramelise with a kitchen torch immediately before serving.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Store covered and chilled for up to 3 days; crisp baked items are best fresh.

title: Greek Skordalia
summary: A punchy garlic-and-potato dip whipped with olive oil and lemon until creamy and smooth.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Peel and boil potatoes until very tender, then drain and steam dry.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Crush garlic with salt into a paste using a mortar or the flat of a knife.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Mash potatoes until smooth, then slowly beat in garlic, olive oil and lemon juice without overworking.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Adjust seasoning and serve at room temperature with vegetables or grilled fish.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if appropriate.

title: Peruvian Causa Limena
summary: Chilled lime-and-chilli mashed potato layers filled with creamy tuna and avocado.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Boil potatoes until tender, drain and mash very smoothly while warm.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Mix potato with lime juice, chilli paste and salt; cool until firm enough to shape.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Mix tuna with mayonnaise and slice avocado; layer half potato, tuna and avocado in a ring mould.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Top with remaining potato, chill 30 minutes and unmould carefully.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if appropriate.

title: Japanese Chawanmushi
summary: Delicate savoury egg custard steamed with dashi, mushrooms and prawns until barely set.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Whisk eggs gently and combine with cooled dashi, soy and mirin; strain through a sieve.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Divide sliced mushrooms and prawns among four heatproof cups.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Pour custard over fillings, cover cups with foil and steam over low heat 15–20 minutes until softly set.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Rest 3 minutes and serve warm, avoiding vigorous boiling that creates bubbles.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if appropriate.

title: Indian Sabudana Khichdi
summary: Tender tapioca pearls tossed with cumin, peanuts, potatoes and lime for a lightly spiced breakfast.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Rinse tapioca pearls and soak in just enough water for 4–6 hours until softened; drain thoroughly.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Dice potato small and fry in ghee until cooked through; add cumin and chopped chilli.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Fold in pearls and crushed peanuts; cook over medium-low heat 5–7 minutes until pearls turn translucent.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Season with salt and lime juice and serve immediately.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if appropriate.

title: French Socca
summary: Thin chickpea-flour flatbread baked until blistered, with crisp edges and a peppery olive-oil finish.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Whisk chickpea flour, water, salt and 1 tbsp oil until smooth; rest 30 minutes.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Heat oven grill to high and place a cast-iron pan inside until very hot.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Carefully oil hot pan, pour in a thin layer of batter and grill 5–8 minutes until blistered and golden.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Scatter black pepper over, slice into wedges and eat while hot.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if appropriate.

title: Portuguese Bifana
summary: Thin pork steaks simmered in garlicky white-wine sauce and tucked into crusty bread rolls.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Slice pork very thinly and lightly pound to even thickness; mince garlic.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Marinate pork with wine, garlic, paprika and bay leaves for 30 minutes in the fridge.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Sear pork quickly in hot oil, add marinade and simmer 5–7 minutes until cooked through.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Stuff warm bread rolls with pork and spoon over a little reduced pan sauce.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if appropriate.

title: Moroccan Baghrir
summary: Soft semolina pancakes dotted with tiny holes that soak up warm honey and melted butter.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Blend semolina, flour, yeast, baking powder and water into a smooth thin batter; rest 30 minutes.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat without greasing heavily.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Pour a small ladle of batter and cook on one side only until bubbles form and surface dries, about 2 minutes.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Stack pancakes without pressing and drizzle with melted butter and honey.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if appropriate.

title: Chinese Sesame Balls
summary: Crisp golden glutinous-rice balls coated in sesame seeds with a sweet red-bean centre.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Dissolve sugar in warm water and mix into glutinous rice flour to make pliable dough.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Divide dough into balls, flatten, enclose a teaspoon of red bean paste and seal carefully.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Roll in sesame seeds; fry at 150–160°C for 6–8 minutes, turning gently until puffed and golden.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Drain on a rack and allow filling to cool slightly before eating.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Store covered and chilled for up to 3 days; crisp baked items are best fresh.

title: Italian Frittata di Zucchine
summary: A tender courgette-and-Parmesan omelette with golden edges and fresh basil.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Thinly slice courgettes and onion; beat eggs with grated Parmesan and pepper.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Cook onion in oil until soft, add courgettes and sauté 8 minutes until moisture evaporates.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Pour eggs over vegetables, reduce heat and cook 5 minutes until edges set; finish under grill 2–3 minutes.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Rest briefly, scatter torn basil over and slice into wedges.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if appropriate.

title: German Rote Grutze
summary: Glossy summer berries gently thickened into a ruby fruit pudding, served with cold vanilla cream.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Wash berries and reserve a handful of delicate fruit for finishing.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Warm cherry juice and sugar, add firmer berries and simmer 3 minutes.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Whisk cornflour with cold water, stir into hot fruit and cook 1–2 minutes until glossy; fold in remaining berries.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Chill until softly set and serve with pouring cream.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Store covered and chilled for up to 3 days; crisp baked items are best fresh.

title: Greek Fasolakia Lathera
summary: Green beans slowly braised with tomatoes, potatoes and olive oil until meltingly tender.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Trim beans, cut potatoes into chunks and grate tomatoes.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Soften onion and garlic in olive oil 8 minutes, then add tomatoes and simmer until fragrant.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Add potatoes, beans and 200 ml water; cover and braise gently 35–40 minutes until tender.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Uncover to reduce sauce, add parsley and serve warm with feta if desired.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if appropriate.

title: Vietnamese Banh Xeo
summary: Crisp turmeric rice crêpes filled with prawns, pork and bean sprouts, wrapped in fresh herbs.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Whisk rice flour, turmeric and coconut milk with 150 ml water; rest batter 20 minutes.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Cook pork strips in a hot non-stick pan until browned; add prawns and cook until opaque.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Pour a thin layer of batter around fillings, scatter sprouts on one half and cover 2 minutes; uncover until edges crisp.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Fold crêpe and serve with mint, lettuce and a lime-fish-sauce dip.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if appropriate.

title: American Devilled Eggs
summary: Creamy mustard-and-mayo yolk filling piped into tender egg whites with a dusting of paprika.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Boil eggs 10 minutes, cool in ice water and peel carefully.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Halve eggs lengthways and scoop yolks into a bowl without tearing whites.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Mash yolks with mayonnaise, mustard and vinegar until smooth; season with salt and pepper.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Spoon or pipe filling into whites and finish with paprika and chives; keep chilled until serving.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if appropriate.

title: Indian Bhindi Masala
summary: Tender okra stir-fried with onions, tomatoes and aromatic spices until lightly crisp and savoury.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Wash okra and dry completely before slicing to reduce sliminess.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Fry okra in hot oil 8–10 minutes until edges brown; remove from pan.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Cook onion, garlic and spices, add tomatoes and reduce to a thick masala.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Return okra and toss gently 3 minutes; season and serve with roti.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if appropriate.

title: French Tarte Flambée
summary: A paper-thin Alsatian flatbread topped with crème fraîche, onions and smoky bacon.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Heat oven to 250°C with a baking tray inside; mix flour, water and oil into smooth dough.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Roll dough very thinly on baking paper and spread with crème fraîche, leaving a small border.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Scatter thin onion slices and bacon lardons evenly over the top.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Slide onto hot tray and bake 10–12 minutes until edges crisp and bacon is cooked; slice and serve hot.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if appropriate.

title: Italian Ricotta Gnocchi
summary: Pillowy ricotta dumplings tossed in brown butter and sage for a delicate, comforting pasta dish.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Drain ricotta thoroughly, then mix with egg, Parmesan and flour just until combined.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Dust work surface lightly, roll mixture into ropes and cut into small pillows without overworking.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Poach gnocchi in gently simmering salted water until they float, about 2–3 minutes.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Brown butter with sage in a pan, add drained gnocchi and toss gently before serving.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if appropriate.

title: Italian Carciofi alla Romana
summary: Tender artichokes braised in olive oil, garlic, mint and lemon in the Roman style.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Trim artichokes to tender hearts and stems, rubbing cut surfaces with lemon to prevent browning.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Chop garlic, parsley and mint and press mixture between artichoke leaves.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Stand artichokes stem-up in a small saucepan with olive oil and water; cover and braise gently 30–40 minutes until a knife slips in easily.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Rest in their cooking juices and serve warm with a squeeze of lemon.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if appropriate.

title: French Ile Flottante
summary: Cloudlike poached meringues floating on chilled vanilla custard with ribbons of amber caramel.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Separate eggs; warm milk with vanilla and whisk yolks with 60 g sugar.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Temper yolks with warm milk, then stir over low heat until custard coats a spoon; strain and chill.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Whisk whites with 40 g sugar to firm peaks; poach spoonfuls in barely simmering water for 1 minute each side.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Make light caramel from remaining sugar and water; serve meringues over cold custard with caramel drizzled on top.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Store covered and chilled for up to 3 days; crisp baked items are best fresh.

title: Lebanese Shish Barak
summary: Tiny lamb-filled dumplings gently simmered in warm garlicky yoghurt sauce with dried mint.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Mix flour and water into a smooth dough and rest 20 minutes; finely chop onion.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Brown lamb and onion together until cooked and dry; cool, then roll dough thin and cut small circles.

stages.title: Cook
steps: Fill and seal dumplings; whisk yoghurt with egg and warm gently, stirring continuously; add dumplings and simmer 12–15 minutes until dough cooks.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Fry garlic and mint briefly in oil and swirl through yoghurt sauce before serving.

tips: Follow the visual and texture cues in the method; pan heat and ingredient size can change cooking times.
variations: Adjust the herbs, chilli or serving accompaniment to taste.
storage: Refrigerate promptly in an airtight container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly if appropriate.

title: Tunisian Lablabi
summary: Warm chickpeas in a cumin-garlic broth poured over torn bread, finished with lemon and harissa.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Drain chickpeas and reserve a little liquid; tear bread into bite-sized pieces and place in deep bowls.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Warm olive oil with crushed garlic and cumin for 30 seconds, then add chickpeas and stock.

stages.title: Cook gently
steps: Simmer 15 minutes, crushing a few chickpeas to give the broth body; season with salt and lemon juice.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Ladle hot chickpeas and broth over bread, add a little harissa to each bowl and serve immediately.

tips: Use a gentle simmer to preserve the texture of the main ingredients.
variations: Adjust fresh herbs and lemon to suit your taste.
storage: Cool promptly and refrigerate in a sealed container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly.

title: Finnish Lohikeitto
summary: Tender salmon, potatoes and leeks in a delicate creamy dill broth with a fresh lemon finish.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Cut salmon into 3 cm cubes; dice potatoes and carrot and wash sliced leeks thoroughly.

stages.title: Build flavour
steps: Melt butter in a pot and soften leeks and carrot for 6 minutes without browning.

stages.title: Cook gently
steps: Add potatoes and stock and simmer 12–15 minutes until potatoes are tender; add salmon and cook gently 4–5 minutes until opaque.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Stir in cream and chopped dill, warm without boiling, then season with lemon juice and black pepper.

tips: Use a gentle simmer to preserve the texture of the main ingredients.
variations: Adjust fresh herbs and lemon to suit your taste.
storage: Cool promptly and refrigerate in a sealed container for up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly.
